name: Extra Assassin Talent
body:
With devoted practice, you have increased your death?dealing ability.

Prerequisite(s): Assassin talent class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional assassin talent. You must meet all of the prerequisites for this assassin talent.

Special: You can gain Extra Assassin Talent multiple times.
